verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a public RESTful API at api.rollbar.com with a reference covering endpoints such as list-all-items, including filtering and pagination examples. It publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec tagged Item, Occurrence, Metrics and Deploy, and uses account/project access tokens for programmatic access. The probe's 404s at standard OpenAPI paths only mean the spec lives at a non-standard URL, not that it is missing. Missing for 10: the docs say the API covers only 'much of' the data rather than all product functionality, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
